expectations.text: On WRITE, bit 7 is the set/clear control: if bit 7 = 1 the 1-bits set (enable) those mask bits; if bit 7 = 0 the 1-bits clear (disable) them
expectations.evidence: "bit 7 = 1 → each 1-bit in value sets (enables) that mask bit; bit 7 = 0 → each 1-bit in value clears (disables) that mask bit"

expectations.text: On READ, the register returns the current interrupt flags
expectations.evidence: "READ ($DC0D PEEK) Returns pending-interrupt flags" with correct bit map

expectations.text: Reading the ICR CLEARS the interrupt flags (and acknowledges/de-asserts the interrupt)
expectations.evidence: "Reading DATA clears all 5 flag bits AND bit 7 to 0, and releases the interrupt line (acknowledges it)"

expectations.text: Bit 7 on READ indicates whether an interrupt occurred (IR flag)
expectations.evidence: "7 | IR — set if any enabled source latched. This is what drove the IRQ/NMI line."
